body:
🟡🧹 **Consider · cleanup: "Open" only closes the card, and only the tooltip says so**

The **Open** button calls `onDismiss`, which does exactly what ✕ does. The page passes `() => setCardDismissedFor(location.key)` (library-detail-page.tsx:253), and the user is already on the recording's page. The only explanation, "Close this and stay on the recording", is in a `title` attribute. Keyboard and screen-reader users don't reliably get `title` tooltips, and the accessible name stays "Open", which suggests the button opens something. Consider a label that matches what the button does, such as "Keep it here" or "Stay on the recording". Alternatively, drop the button, since ✕ already covers this.

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of Cristian Sotomayor**

Fixed in [`50c98b40`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/commit/50c98b4084683bac5b6cc41f4ccb85f70dd5b40b) on #471 (top of the stack): the in-app card no longer renders Open (it only closed the card, like ✕); Open shows only on the floating window, where `onOpen` opens the recording. The owner can overrule this design call.
